name: Paws & Fries
tagline: Snow leopards, fake fries & a very yellow puppet

cards.name: Fat Talking Tom and Angela
cards.caption: Starting my diet tomorrow
cards.flavor: Oct 12, 2026: pudgy Talking Tom and Angela edits became matching pfps and lazy-day mood.
cards.art: Talking Tom, the grey cat in a blue paw-print shirt, edited chubby, standing by a pink flower stream (KYM gallery image; the Angela half of the pair is not shown).

cards.name: Randy Marsh
cards.caption: What's up, brah?
cards.flavor: Oct 2026: South Park's Randy squares up for a bro down with Bane, Steve and an ICE agent.
cards.art: Randy Marsh mid bro-down, arms spread, in his teal shirt on white (Know Your Meme's main image for What's Up Brah?).

cards.name: Ronnie Coleman Fries
cards.caption: Everybody thought fries
cards.flavor: A 2024 Club Shay Shay clip about oven potatoes became October 2026's 'not fries' template.
cards.art: Still of Ronnie Coleman in a blue polo during his 2024 Club Shay Shay interview, cropped from Know Your Meme's main image.

cards.name: Snow Leopard Paws At You
cards.caption: *paws at you*
cards.flavor: Oct 2026: a zoo snow leopard got Mei Mei the cat's face and a very pointed paw.
cards.art: A 2024 Ishikawa Zoo snow leopard photo by @black03_white03 with the Mei Mei cat face swapped in, paw raised (the edit as screenshotted by @harvest_skies).

cards.name: Saitama vs. Goku
cards.caption: Goku wins? Cope.
cards.flavor: Oct 18, 2026: Death Battle let Goku beat Saitama and fans lost their minds.
cards.art: Saitama glaring, from the Saitama half of Death Battle's thumbnail for the episode (Know Your Meme's main image), cropped to leave out the logo.

cards.name: Liberty Biberty
cards.caption: Boston wants him gone
cards.flavor: Liberty Mutual's yellow puppet mascot drew about 100 protesters in Boston in Oct 2026.
cards.art: Still from the Liberty Mutual ad of Biberty, the Henson-made yellow fur ball in a Statue of Liberty crown (Know Your Meme's main image), cropped to leave out the logo.

cards.name: Scientists Reveal the Hi
cards.caption: The secret is: Hi
cards.flavor: Oct 2026: a wide-eyed ginger cat and a fake BBC headline that always ends in a tiny 'Hi'.
cards.art: The orange cat from the BBC's May 2025 ginger-cat article thumbnail, as used in the meme (Know Your Meme's main image), cropped to leave out the caption.
